hubText: Follow us, tag us, DM us. The Timber Bros community lives across social platforms — come say g'day and share what you're building.

testimonials.text: Finally a podcast that actually talks like a tradie, not like they're reading from a script. The chainsaw mill episode is the most useful hour of audio I've ever listened to in the shed.
testimonials.author: — Craig M.

testimonials.text: I was struggling badly with my mental health last year and stumbled onto the Bloke Check-In episode. It changed something for me. I made an appointment the next week. Cheers lads.
testimonials.author: — Anonymous

testimonials.text: As a woman running a timber studio, it means the world to see a show that's not just blokes talking to blokes. The Women in Timber episode had me crying in the workshop. Best kind of cry.
testimonials.author: — Tess R.

testimonials.text: Hazy and Plummo have the best chemistry of any podcast I listen to. You can tell they actually like each other and the craft. That energy is infectious.
testimonials.author: — Barry K.

testimonials.text: I put this on when I'm milling and it makes the day fly. Educational, funny, and they don't treat you like an idiot. Exactly what the Aussie woodworking scene needed.
testimonials.author: — Mike T.

testimonials.text: The hardwood species episode should be required listening for every woodworker in this country. Printed the species guide and put it on the workshop wall.
testimonials.author: — Dan W.
